title: The Prince of Liechtenstein walked up to a UFO in the mountains
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of The Prince of Liechtenstein walked up to a UFO in the mountains, about unspecified at mountains (unspecified), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that in and Lawrence told us that you know because he said that's why he was so convinced that it was true that his friend who was the prince of Likenstein had seen one

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says on a podcast that Laurance Rockefeller, a wealthy philanthropist, once told him and others, including the psychiatrist John Mack, why he was so convinced UFOs were real. According to Sheehan, Rockefeller said his friend, the Prince of Liechtenstein, had seen one, walking up to it somewhere in the mountains. For Sheehan, it shows that a powerful man's belief rested on a trusted friend's own encounter.
